author: China Insights
description:
A series of unusual developments has drawn attention across China's financial sector: tightening restrictions on cross-border investment platforms, increased scrutiny of offshore accounts, and continued concerns over debt, deflation, and capital outflows.

At the same time, China's money supply has reached historic highs, raising an important question: if so much liquidity exists, why does economic activity remain so weak?

In this episode, we examine the financial signals behind these developments and revisit one of history's most famous monetary crises — Weimar Germany. By comparing debt burdens, capital controls, investor behaviour, and policy responses, we explore what lessons history may offer and why some analysts believe recent events deserve closer attention.

This is not a prediction. It is an examination of patterns, incentives, and historical parallels that continue to shape financial systems today.

#China #Economy #Finance #WeimarGermany #Investing #CapitalControls #Finan
title: Is China Entering a Weimar Moment? The Financial Signals Raising Alarms I China Insights
